images.concept: Editorial dark studio portrait of a confident Latin American man in his early 30s, mid-shot from the waist up, standing three-quarter turn toward a warm directional light from camera-left. He holds a matte black tablet at his waist with a muted abstract interface glowing softly on its screen. His gaze is slightly off-camera, calm and deliberate, like a founder mid-conversation with his team. The background is a textured charcoal plaster wall with a slow vignette. Warm rim light catches the edge of his shoulder and jaw, crushed deep shadows fall on the right side.
images.composition: Subject offset to the RIGHT third. The entire LEFT 42% of the frame is intentionally empty shadow space — this is where the main headline typography lives. Top 16% reserved for a small eyebrow label. Bottom 14% clear for handle and logo to be added in overlay later. Editorial magazine layout energy. Shallow depth of field softens the tablet and background.

continuity.connectsToNext: the tablet becomes the subject of slide 02 — camera pulls in toward the glowing screen
